decision_note: Primary Brassica rapa study links herbivore-induced floral volatile change to pollinator visitation and plant fitness; retain for same-trait/estimand adjudication.
Three-year nine-population Corydalis study jointly examines nectar thieves, nectar robbers, legitimate pollinators and reproductive fitness; retain for role/context and estimand adjudication.

Abronia floral-colour transition-zone study measures floral pigmentation, herbivory/florivory and reproductive success across contrasting sites; retain for source-level selection/context adjudication.
Lobelia study explicitly estimates standardized floral-trait selection under natural versus supplemental pollination and quantifies herbivore-mediated paths to seed fitness.
Brassica experiment estimates directional selection gradients on floral signals under bumble-bee, cabbage-butterfly and combined consumer regimes using relative seed set.
Primary thesis explicitly tests herbivore- and pollinator-mediated selection on floral display in Lythrum salicaria; retain for full-text estimand adjudication.
